selection: a present device is selected when its instance id starts with one of the prefixes or its class is one of the classes

resolver.device: SetupDiOpenDeviceInfoW on the instance id, OpenFlags 0, in a private device information set
resolver.subkeys: RegOpenKeyExW relative to the returned handle, options 0, KEY_READ
resolver.values: RegEnumValueW on the two leaves only

protection: a Bluetooth peer node (any BTH enumerator other than the radio's own, or a Bluetooth service UUID in the id) has its name fields and twelve digit addresses replaced by name- and mac- pseudonyms before anything is written; string typed values are not kept (free text)
read_only: keys are opened for reading only (KEY_READ); a missing key is recorded as absent and never created; a key that could not be opened is recorded as unknown
